matches.description: Watch Borussia Dortmund vs Eintracht Frankfurt highlights and goals from Bundesliga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 8, 2026. Late Drama as Dortmund Edges Frankfurt in Thrilling Bundesliga Encounter A thrilling encounter marked the matchday of May 8, 2026, as Borussia Dortmund hosted Eintracht Frankfurt . The fixture promised high-level football, and both sides delivered a spectacle full of twists and turns, and moments of pure tension. Frankfurt Takes an Early Lead, Dortmund Responds Fiercely The visiting side, Eintracht Frankfurt , drew first blood. In the 2nd minute, Can Uzun opened the scoring with a precise left-footed strike, assisted by Mahmoud Dahoud . The initial lead seemed to give the visitors control, but Borussia Dortmund would demonstrate their resilience. Before halftime, the hosts orchestrated a spectacular comeback. In the 42nd minute, Serhou Guirassy equalized with a right-footed goal, following a crucial pass from Julian Ryerson , who was himself assisted by Marcel Sabitzer . Just three minutes later, deep into first-half stoppage time, Dortmund completed the turnaround. Nico Schlotterbeck scored with his left foot, with Maximilian Beier providing the decisive pass after a build-up involving Jobe Bellingham . Second Half of Tactics and Anxiety Borussia Dortmund solidified their advantage in the second half. In the 72nd minute, Samuele Inacio extended the lead to 3-1 with a right-footed goal, assisted by Maximilian Beier , who in turn received a key pass from Jobe Bellingham . The home side appeared to have the game under control, but Eintracht Frankfurt refused to give up. The Frankfurt side mounted a late surge that kept the game electrifying until the final whistle. In the 87th minute, Jonathan Burkardt reduced the deficit to 3-2 with a left-footed shot, injecting hope into his team. The match saw a series of substitutions from both camps, with managers looking to bolster their lines for the decisive moments. In the dying minutes, Dortmund saw Samuele Inacio and Gregor Kobel receive yellow cards for time-wasting, a clear attempt to hold onto the result. Borussia Dortmund thus managed to secure all three points at home, in a match that tested the nerves of all involved, culminating with the final whistle after four minutes of added time.

matches.description: Watch Borussia M'gladbach vs Borussia Dortmund highlights and goals from Bundesliga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 3, 2026. A packed house witnessed a high-stakes Bundesliga encounter as Borussia M'gladbach hosted Borussia Dortmund in a match defined by tactical discipline and technological intervention. Both sides navigated a cagey affair where the smallest of margins threatened to decide the outcome under the lights. A Tense Opening Exchange On May 3, 2026 , over 54,000 spectators filled the stands for this highly anticipated fixture, creating an electric atmosphere that belied the cautious approach taken by both managers in the opening stages. Borussia M'gladbach appeared to have found the breakthrough early in the 25th minute when Nico Elvedi found the back of the net, but the celebrations were cut short. A lengthy VAR review determined the defender was in an offside position, keeping the scoreline level. Yannik Engelhardt also went close for the hosts with a header that drifted wide, while Dortmund struggled to find their usual fluidity in the final third, leading to a stalemate as the first half drew to a close. Tactical Shifts and Rising Temperatures The second half saw an increase in physical intensity as both teams fought for control of the midfield. In the 54th minute, Kevin Stöger was cautioned for a cynical shirt-pull, followed shortly by Nico Schlotterbeck of Borussia Dortmund receiving a yellow card for a dangerous challenge. As the game entered its final quarter, Dortmund manager introduced fresh legs in the form of Fabio Silva , Salih Ozcan , and later Carney Chukwuemeka , attempting to break the deadlock. Gladbach responded with chances of their own, most notably a stinging long-range effort from Yannik Engelhardt in the 81st minute that whistled just past the upright. Late Drama and VAR Confirmation The defining moment of the match arrived in the 88th minute. Rocco Reitz showcased excellent vision to create a scoring opportunity for Haris Tabaković , who made no mistake with a clinical right-footed finish. The stadium erupted, but play was once again halted for a VAR check to verify the legitimacy of the goal. After a tense wait, the referee signaled that the goal stood in the 90th minute. Tabaković was so swept up in the emotion of the moment that he received a yellow card for his celebrations, but his contribution proved decisive. In a frantic four minutes of stoppage time, Borussia Dortmund pushed forward through Yan Couto and Daniel Svensson , but the Gladbach defense, led by timely interceptions from Joseph Scally , held firm. The final whistle confirmed a significant victory for the home side, rewarding their persistence in a match where every inch was contested.
